publisher: Each state and territorial legislative chamber and the Council of the District of Columbia (its own adopted rules, journals or official legislature pages)
vintage: rules in force for the 2023-2026 sessions
table: Who appoints the members (and, where the rule says, the chairs) of each chamber's standing committees
title: Standing committee appointment rule by chamber, 2026
universe: Every state and territorial legislative chamber and the Council of the District of Columbia: the chamber rows of data/research/legislature/chamber-leadership.json other than Congress (108 rows).
geography: chamber, keyed by jurisdictionKey (US-<postal code>) and chamberKey as in chamber-leadership.json
limits: A SOURCED row quotes the chamber's own rule (or the legislature's official page describing it) as fetched on Oct 23, 2026. An ESTIMATED row is the chamber template's default from chamber-leadership.json because the chamber's own rule was not fetched in this pass; it is a stand-in, not a reading. The Council of State Governments' Book of the States 2023, Table 3.23 was read only to decide which chambers to check first; none of its rows are copied here (its data license is noncommercial). Rules change each session; a chamber can suspend or amend them by resolution. Vocabulary: speaker, senate-president (the chamber's president, elected or the lieutenant governor), president-pro-tempore, majority-leader, party-caucuses (each caucus seats its own members), committee-on-committees (a leadership panel, by whatever name: Committee on Assignments, Committee on Organization, Committee on Rules), chamber-election (the chamber votes the slate), seniority (members choose seats in order of service), council-chair.
readBy: scripts/research/legislature-local-rules-check.ts (shape and vocabulary check; reports how many chambers differ from their template). No engine reads it yet: gov-leadership-committee-appointer-by-chamber is the builder item for src/core2/modules/leadership.ts assigner().

rows.quote: There shall be a Senate Committee on Assignments which shall be composed of the President Pro Tempore, the Senate Majority Leader, and four additional members appointed by and serving at the pleasure of the President Pro Tempore. The Committee on Assignments shall appoint the Chairperson, Vice Chairperson, and membership of all Senate Standing Committees and Select Committees.

rows.rule: Uniform Rule 1(e), Uniform Rules adopted 2021, as amended 2023 (both houses)
rows.quote: The presiding officer shall announce, not later than the day following election, the appointment of a Committee on Committees consisting of five members including the presiding officer. The presiding officer chairs the Committee on Committees. The committee is responsible for nominating the members of the standing committees as set out in Rule 20 and the member who is to chair each standing committee

rows.quote: The President shall appoint all standing committees, and all select committees unless otherwise ordered by the Senate by a majority of the members present, and shall appoint the chairman and vice-chairman of each such committee.

rows.quote: Each Class "A" standing committee and each Class "B" standing committee shall have five (5) members from each of the four (4) House district caucuses. (B)(i) The most senior member of the House of Representatives shall select first and shall choose a position on a Class "A" standing committee.

rows.rule: Senate Rule 7(c), Rules of the Senate 2025-2028 (S.R. 1704, enrolled)
rows.quote: The Committee on Organization, Calendar and Rules shall appoint the chairperson and vice chairperson or vice chairpersons thereof and shall designate the ranking minority member of each committee. ... rows.quote: Rule 39. Appointment of Committees. The Committee on Committees shall appoint[ the Chair, Vice-Chairs and] the members of all standing and special committees and shall fill any vacancies thereon.

rows.quote: The Senate Majority Leader shall make appointments of Senators to committees and subcommittees established under these rules. The Senate Majority Leader shall make appointments of minority party members from a list submitted by the Senate Minority Leader

rows.rule: Minnesota Legislature, frequently asked questions: committees
rows.quote: In the House, the Speaker chooses the committee chairs and appoints members of each committee.

rows.rule: Minnesota Legislature, frequently asked questions: committees
rows.quote: The number of members on a committee is designated by the majority caucus, and membership on each committee must be in proportion to each caucus. Each caucus appoints their own members to fill the designated number of positions on each committee.
